I am an old man now, 67 years, and I have been farming this land in Mzimba for many seasons. This maize plot is small, only a bit more than half a hectare, but I own it and I know it well. I went to school for a few years so I can read what is written on the fertilizer bag, and I usually get a coupon from the subsidy which helps me buy one bag of NPK and one bag of urea — without that coupon the price is too much for me. I will plant hybrid seed because that is what works with the fertilizer, and I will put my goat manure on the plot before the rains since I have animals at home. I do not have a pump or a stream nearby so I wait for the rains like everyone here. My sons and grandchildren help me weed because my back is not strong like before, and at planting and weeding time I pay a few young men from the village to help finish on time.
